title: Output, collapsed duplicates, selection on multiple lines
body: ### Tested versions ### Reproducible in: v4.8.dev4.official [b56a91878] v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf] ### System information Godot v4.8.dev4 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (853x683 @ 60.02 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description In the Output panel, when duplicate messages are collapsed, then a text selection can appear on multiple lines. ### Steps to reproduce - open project: [output_collapse_duplicates_selection_on_multiple_lines.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31861920/output_collapse_duplicates_selection_on_multiple_lines.zip) - open the output panel - enable the bottom left button: Collapse duplicate messages - in the scene panel, click: 2D Scene The output panel shows: New Scene Root - click the node's eye icon The output panel added: Toggle visible - in the filesystem panel, open: new_script.gd it prints the same message twice: ``` @tool extends EditorScript func _run(): print('Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit') print('Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit') ``` - right-click on new_script.gd and choose: Run - in the output panel, select text ### Issue Parts of the last line are selected when selecting text on the first or second lines. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3627aca5-e281-459f-868f-aa77b202df1b The selection also appears on each collapsed line when repeating: - toggle the nodes visibility - run the script ### Notes Copying text in the output panel, only copies the manually selected text, not where the selection appears on the other lines. The selection issue stops when toggling off or back on collapse duplicates. But it returns when multiple lines are printed again. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [output_collapse_duplicates_selection_on_multiple_lines.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31861920/output_collapse_duplicates_selection_on_multiple_lines.zip)
